visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-top banner with a full-bleed photo (or colour) background, a main text box (heading, text, ticks, CTAs) and an optional side panel (offer, lifestage links, 'this page covers' contents)

contentPattern.structure: a picture-only cell is the background (with `logo`, it is a brand mark beside the copy); the first text cell is the main text box (heading, text, lists, CTA links); a second text cell becomes the side panel; further picture-only cells sit with the copy. Cells can be in one row or separate rows

usage: Top-of-page hero on most content pages (304 pages default) and product/landing pages: text boxes over photos, offer boxes, link panels, contents panels, logo banners, text overlays and promo cards.
reuseGuidance: Use for the page-top banner with copy over or beside an image. Use hero-title for plain title bands without a photo, and columns-media for in-page image/text splits. `text-box*`/`offer-box*`/`promo-card` pad the text box; `text-box` puts it on the right; `offer-box*` drop the second (offer) panel low; `link-panel`/`contents-panel` render the second cell as a list panel; `logo` treats the picture as a brand mark; `text-overlay` keeps copy directly on the photo.
